articleTitle: What to Say When You Learn About a Death Months Later
imageHeadline: It's not too late to reach out
imageSubtext: How to offer support when you learn about a loss months later
pinTitle: What to Say When You Learn About a Death Months Later | Supporting a Grieving Friend
pinDescription: You just found out your friend lost someone important months ago. Grief doesn't follow a timeline, and your support still matters. Learn what to say, what to avoid, and how to show up when the immediate grief window has passed.

items.label: Acknowledge you just found out and you're sorry
Use the person's name, not 'your loss'
Follow up again in a few weeks

backgroundScene: A quiet kitchen table with two mugs of tea and a hand-written note beside a phone, warm afternoon light streaming through a window
